scope_basis: The pinned upstream README states that DINOv2 code and model weights are released under Apache-2.0. The pinned source files carry Apache-2.0 notices.
allowed_probe_assets: General DINOv2 ViT-S/14 implementation from the pinned repository commit

checkpoint_integrity.provenance: Computed 2026-10-12 by streaming the complete primary published checkpoint URL to shasum -a 256; no local checkpoint file was retained.
checkpoint_integrity.etag_note: The multipart ETag is recorded only as HTTP object metadata, not represented as a SHA-256 or other content digest.
checkpoint_integrity.upstream_digest_status: No upstream-published cryptographic digest was found in the pinned README, model factory, or response headers; the SHA-256 above is locally measured.

excluded_assets: Cell-DINO models and checkpoints, which have distinct licensing
XRay-DINO model and checkpoint, which have distinct licensing
Any checkpoint whose provenance and license have not been verified
handling: Keep required Apache-2.0 license and notice text with any redistribution of covered upstream code or weights; review upstream NOTICE and applicable attribution obligations before redistribution.
limitations: This records upstream licensing for the specified probe assets. It is not legal advice and does not establish rights to challenge images or other datasets.
